senses.en: the act of admitting one’s crimes, faults, etc.
examples: I have a [[confession]] to make — I scraped (擦坏) your car when I was parking mine.

senses.en: use all or most of your time, effort, etc. in order to do sth. or help sb.
examples: After graduating from law school, he [[devoted]] his energies to writing film scripts.

senses.en: showing great fondness or loyalty; caring a great deal
examples: There is absolutely no doubt that this woman was a totally [[devoted]] and caring mother.

senses.en: impossible to satisfy
examples: The public has an [[insatiable]] appetite for stories about famous people.

senses.en: a very strong desire for sth.
examples: Surprisingly, his headache and fatigue subsided (减轻) and his [[craving]] for alcohol disappeared.

senses.zh: 来自热带的；产于热带的；热带的
senses.en: coming from, found in, or typical of the tropics
examples: Under normal conditions, the ocean currents of the [[tropical]] Pacific travel from east to west.

senses.en: difficult in an interesting or enjoyable way
examples: Mike found a [[challenging]] job as a computer programmer.

senses.en: gradually become familiar with a new situation
examples: I felt I had [[adjusted]] to the idea of being a mother very well.

senses.en: (BrE hall of residence, infml.)
(esp. BrE, infml.)
(pl. zucchini or zucchinis) (BrE courgette)
the power or opportunity to use sb. / sth.
examples: During their visit, I left my car at their [[disposal]].

senses.en: the act or means of getting rid of sth.
examples: We should not give up this option for the [[disposal]] of nuclear waste.

senses.en: examine or consider with attention and in detail
examples: Officials of the union are [[perusing]] the deal.

senses.en: (fml.) read sth, esp. in a careful way
examples: She found the information while she was [[perusing]] a copy of Life magazine.

senses.en: in a worried or unhappy way
examples: "We have to get those windows open," I announced [[grimly]] to my husband.

senses.en: seriously
examples: "Now, I can wait for you," he said [[grimly]], "but hurry up."

senses.en: (fruit or vegetables) dry and not tasting good
examples: The apples we bought yesterday are kind of [[mealy]].

senses.en: of a light shade of red
examples: Her nostrils (鼻孔) were [[pinkish]], as though she had a cold.

senses.en: (also ~ up) put paper or cloth over sth. to cover it
examples: He [[wrapped]] a bandage around my injured wrist.

senses.en: the piece of paper or plastic that covers sth. when it is sold
examples: The kids were asked to put the sweet [[wrappers]] into the rubbish bin.

senses.zh: （水果和蔬菜的）外皮（尤指橙子等不能食用的厚皮）
senses.en: the skin of some fruit and vegetables, esp. the thick skin of fruit such as oranges, which you do not eat
examples: Usually, we speak of orange [[peel]] and apple [[peel]], but of tomato skin.

senses.zh: 剥去（削去）（水果或蔬菜）的皮
senses.en: remove the skin from fruit or vegetables
examples: She sat down in the kitchen and began to [[peel]] potatoes.

senses.en: not having a lot of experience of life
examples: I cannot believe you have such [[unworldly]] views on things as a grown man.

senses.zh: 对钱财不感兴趣；脱俗的
senses.en: not interested in money or possessions
examples: The singer seems somewhat [[unworldly]] because he hates commercial advertising and social activities.

senses.zh: 有文化的；有教养的；有修养的
senses.en: having or showing good education, manners, and an interest in art, music, literature, etc.
examples: The people who will be on the committee are moral, [[cultured]], and competent.

senses.en: (BrE also realisation) the process of becoming aware of sth.
examples: There is now a growing [[realization]] that things cannot go on like this for much longer.

senses.zh: （因习以为常）视···为理所当然（而对其不重视）
senses.en: (take sb. / sth. for granted) be so used to sb. / sth. that you do not recognize their true value any more and do not show that you are grateful
examples: I came into adult life clueless about a lot of things that most people take for [[granted]].

senses.en: (fml.) give sb. sth. or allow them to have sth. that they have asked for
examples: In response to the lawyer's appeals, the Home Secretary [[granted]] a free pardon (赦免).

senses.en: the reason why you want to do sth.
examples: What was your [[motivation]] for becoming a doctor?

senses.en: eagerness and willingness to do sth. without needing to be told or forced to do it
examples: Jack is an intelligent pupil, but he lacks [[motivation]].

senses.zh: 优先处理的事；当务之急
senses.en: sth. that needs attention, consideration, service, etc. before others
examples: After several burglaries (入室盗窃) in the area, security is now a high [[priority]].

senses.en: of the color of gold
examples: He was so attracted by the girl with [[golden]] hair that he did not hear anything his father said.

senses.en: the sound of sth. being crushed or like sth. being crushed or broken
examples: I heard a loud [[crunch]] as the truck ran into the wall.

senses.zh: 不使用化肥的；有机的；绿色的
senses.en: relating to farming or gardening methods of growing food without using artificial chemicals, or produced or grown by these methods
examples: Now [[organic]] farming is expanding everywhere in China.

senses.en: relating to a type of farming which allows animals such as chickens and pigs to move around and eat naturally, rather than being kept in a restricted space
examples: She says that [[free-range]] chickens taste much better than factory-farmed ones.

senses.en: (fml.) take part in an activity or event
examples: China will actively [[participate]] in global affairs and play a constructive role in maintaining world peace.

senses.en: become or make sth. become liquid as a result of heating
examples: The snow had [[melted]], but the lake was still frozen solid.

senses.en: (fml.) food which keeps people or animals strong and healthy
examples: Throughout human history we have depended on nature for [[sustenance]], well-being, and development.

senses.en: very great
examples: The mother's behavior has a [[profound]] impact on the developing child.

senses.en: having a great influence or effect
examples: The report outlines the most [[far-reaching]] changes in housing policy for 30 years.

senses.en: grave problems, situations, or worries are very great or bad
examples: The situation poses a [[grave]] threat to world peace.

senses.en: a place in the ground where a dead body is buried
examples: She tore the rose apart and scattered the petals (花瓣) over the [[grave]].

senses.en: a statement about what you think is going to happen, or the act of making this statement
examples: He was unwilling to make a [[prediction]] about which books would sell well in the coming year.

senses.en: pass or assist sb. in passing (a difficult, testing experience, or period)
examples: I don't know how we're going to [[get through]] the winter.

senses.en: laugh, or cause others to laugh, rather unkindly at
examples: People [[make fun of]] her because she wears such a strange hat.

senses.en: able to be used freely by sb.
examples: We will use all the means at our disposal to solve this problem.

senses.en: recognize sb. / sth. in a group of people or things
examples: Steven describes himself as "a regular guy — you couldn't [[pick out]] me out of a crowd."

senses.zh: 把···秘而不宣；不将···说出去
senses.en: not tell anyone about sth.
examples: I have to tell someone. I can't [[keep it to myself]].

senses.en: be very different from sth; not be connected with sth.
examples: Many of these books are far removed from the reality of children's lives.

senses.en: be dependent on
examples: They have to [[rely on]] the river for their water.

senses.en: (of fruit or vegetables) easily available and ready to eat because it is the right time of year for them
examples: These are the dog days (伏天); watermelons are just in season.

senses.en: following in order or importance after sb. / sth.
examples: [[Next to]] biology, I like physics best.

senses.en: mostly; usually
examples: These small pieces of land were purchased [[for the most part]] by local people.

senses.en: in the future
examples: She might be able to help you pursue a promotion [[down the road]].

senses.zh: 阿巴拉契亚（美国东部地区）
